description.value: Ladner Community Centre is a two-storey municipal recreation facility operated by the City of Delta, located in the Ladner neighbourhood. It offers fitness programs, recreation activities, and community services. Touring cyclists passing through the flat farmland of south Delta will find it a convenient public facility with washrooms.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is almost entirely City of Delta navigation menus with very little facility-specific detail for Ladner Community Centre. OSM tags confirm toilets=yes, and the facility is a municipal community centre operated by the City of Delta under Parks & Recreation. No evidence was found on the website for bike parking, water refill, showers, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities. The OSM toilets tag is treated as reliable for a public municipal facility.
concerns: Website content was mostly navigation menus; facility-specific amenity details could not be extracted
Community is listed as Tsawwassen in OSM record but the facility is in Ladner
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A public municipal community centre with confirmed washrooms, but the website content was too thin to verify bike parking or water refill. Only one of three required criteria could be confirmed. May still be a useful waypoint for touring cyclists in Ladner but needs manual verification of cycling amenities.

wow_evidence: Municipal rec facility with washrooms — walk-in public centre.
blurb: Two-storey municipal community centre in Ladner.
